hypothesis: The out-of-time physics teacher advantage over its matched control teacher isolates privileged physical information. Regressing only that centered advantage from legal history features should recover predictable repertoire-level physics while avoiding the calibration and duplicate-control signal that harmed the prior full-probability soft student.

relation_to_prior_failures.profile_distillation: The prior E80 experiment aggregated teacher values into nine fixed tables and appended them to the outcome model; this model directly learns the per-pitch teacher advantage.
relation_to_prior_failures.soft_student: The prior soft student imitated the centered full physics-teacher probability and therefore duplicated its weaker control model; this student targets physics_teacher minus control_teacher only and is added to exact C as a residual.

privileged_training_contract.teacher_target: 0.5 + (physics_teacher - control_teacher) centered within each completed source season

selection.locked_rule: maximize minimum full-score gain across both development years and all anchors among trials with positive R point gain and positive pitcher-cluster R CI lower bound in every cell
